create_depth_estimation_pipeline: create a depth estimation pipeline to predict image depth from a HuggingFace model
run_depth_estimation_single_image: run depth estimation on a single image URL and return predicted depth tensor and visualization
run_depth_estimation_batch_images: run depth estimation on a batch of images and return a list of predicted depth results
preprocess_image_for_depth_model: preprocess an image with an image processor and return model inputs with target size metadata
postprocess_depth_model_outputs: postprocess model outputs to normalize predicted depth and convert to PIL depth image
